en: A black-and-white postcard depicting a large institutional complex surrounded by forested hills and open land. The buildings are long, multi-story, and uniform, with many windows. In the background are rolling hills and a scattering of houses, suggesting a rural or semi-rural location. The lower left corner of the postcard contains the printed words 'Sundsvall. Sidsjöns sjukhus.' and the number '567' appears in the lower right.
